title: Plumbing — Template 2 (FlowForce)
notes: FlowForce: bold high-contrast plumbing site in charcoal, electric blue and lime. 42 static pages incl. /projects/[slug]. Interactive service selector, postal-code area checker against configured coverage, project filters, estimate form with conditional fields. Every business detail is a placeholder in src/config/business.ts; credentials, emergency cover and reviews stay hidden until verified. Form needs NEXT_PUBLIC_QUOTE_ENDPOINT (worker included). Photos are free-licence Unsplash stock.
